messages:
oncall-bot Automated alert: latency spike detected for route /v1/stream (p99 > 2.5s) · 3379991111

oncall-bot Incident severity: SEV3 — live degradation, possible cache miss storm. Paging on-call: @maria_sre · :rotating_light:

maria_sre yep saw it. investigating now. p95 up ~300ms -> 800ms, p99 trending 2s->3s. streaming tail stalls reported by ingestion teams.

kevin_prod jumping in — any deploys around spike?

maria_sre not that I can see in deploy bot logs. last model rollout was earlier and stable. I pulled per-shard metrics: several prefix-cache hit rates dropped from ~94% -> 32% starting 3379991070.

laura_eng FYI we did a prefix-hash change rolled out yesterday morning to reduce collisions. Could be related.

ajay_research hmm prefix-hash tweak might change namespace mapping leading to cold misses. Do we have recent invalidation runs?

maria_sre running quick query: `SELECT avg(hit_rate) FROM cache_metrics WHERE prefix_scheme = 'v3' AND ts > 3379991000` shows drop concentrated on kv-buckets 17-21.

kevin_prod customers on dedicated capacity seeing higher p99s? any customer escalations?

derek_support two enterprise teams reported slow streaming sessions and one raised a ticket — CS triage says partial impact (degraded responses, retries). No full outages.

maria_sre mitigation plan: 1) throttle new prefix-hash rollout 2) force warm-up for affected buckets (parallel prefetch) 3) fallback routing to backup prefix-scheme v2 for high latency traffic. Starting step 1 now.

ops-runbook-bot Runbook check: suggested mitigation for large cache miss waves -> rollback prefix rollout OR route to fallback model variant. See: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/cache-miss-storm

laura_eng can we do a config flip to route traffic from prefix-scheme v3->v2 for critical customer paths? That's low-risk and quick.

maria_sre starting config flip for route rule `route: /v1/stream -> prefix_scheme: v2` for prod-critical tag. Command: `rbctl set-route --route /v1/stream --preferscheme v2 --selector critical=true`

ajay_research note: v2 has slightly higher token cost but better caching behavior historically. good trade for SLOs.

kevin_prod rolling now, will monitor.

oncall-bot Config change completed: `rbctl` returned 0. New route rule effective in ~15s.

maria_sre metrics update: p95 reduced from 800ms -> 420ms in 45s, p99 trending down from 3s -> 1.8s. Cache hit rate for buckets 17-21 slowly climbing to ~58%.

derek_support I'm messaging the affected customers that we've mitigated and are investigating root cause; will flag if any need extra escalation.

laura_eng we should also seed prefetch for hot keys in the affected buckets while they warm. launching prefetch job with concurrency=12.

maria_sre started prefetch job: `prefetcher --buckets 17-21 --concurrency 12 --mode conservative`

ajay_research quick check of logs shows a small but meaningful pattern: a subset of client IDs had sudden key-space skew after v3 mapping change. Might be a mapping bug in the rollout script that left some prefixes salted differently.

kevin_prod if that's the case we need to audit the rollout. can we pause and snapshot the rollout config?

maria_sre paused automated rollout and created snapshot `rollout-snap-3379991138`.

ops-runbook-bot Suggestion: run `kv-checksum` on affected buckets to detect mismatched prefixes.

laura_eng running `kv-checksum --buckets 17-21 --compare v2 v3` now. ETA ~2m.

maria_sre update: prefetch warmed the most frequent keys; p95 now ~260ms, p99 ~720ms. customer visible errors reduced to negligible.

laura_eng checksum finished: mismatches found for ~0.9% of keys in those buckets — looks like an off-by-one salt applied during v3 rollout for a small subset of nodes.

ajay_research that explains low hit rate. root fix: patch rollout script to correct salt application, then roll a targeted fix for affected nodes. Longer term: add canary sampling by kv-checksum after rollout.

kevin_prod timeline: hotfix patch -> small coordinated restart of 4 nodes in bucket range, then re-enable rollout. Can we schedule immediate hotfix?

maria_sre patch built, testing in staging now.

oncall-bot NOTE: This thread will be handed off to next on-call in 60m unless explicitly reassigned.

derek_support CS update sent to customers at 3379991300: "We've applied mitigations (route fallback + prefetch). We are continuing root-cause work and will update with timeline for a targeted fix."

maria_sre hotfix test pass in staging. Planning to apply to node set A (4 nodes) with rolling restart and checksum verify. Will execute at 3379991380.

laura_eng executing hotfix now: `deploy-safely --nodes node-a{1..4} --script fix-salt.sh`

maria_sre verify step: `kv-checksum --buckets 17-21 --mode verify` -> reports mismatches reduced to 0.01%. p99 down to 320ms after verify.

ajay_research follow-ups: 1) add automated post-rollout kv-checksum for canary nodes 2) add metric alert for sudden drop in prefix hit rate 3) add a rollback gate in rollout pipeline.

kevin_prod agreed. also, add a note to release docs about salt semantics.

maria_sre handing off to night on-call @kevin_prod at 3379991450. Current state: routes fallback still active for critical tag (can be reverted once rollout re-enabled), hotfix applied to affected nodes, prefetch running and gradual cache warm-up ongoing. No active customer escalations.

oncall-bot Handoff completed. New on-call: kevin_prod. Thread closed for active ops, keep updates in this thread if anything changes.

kevin_prod thanks all. I'll monitor p99 and cache hit metrics through the night and pick up next steps in the morning. Please add any postmortem notes to the incident doc: https://intra.redwood/incidents/3379991111-paging-prefetch-eviction-triage

maria_sre adding preliminary RCA note: prefix-hash rollout script applied salt offset for a small subset of nodes causing 0.9% of keys to remap -> cache miss storm -> elevated p99 -> streaming stalls. Mitigations: route fallback, prefetch warming, hotfix to rollout script, targeted node patch.

laura_eng :thumbsup: good recovery. follow-ups assigned in ops tracker.

kevin_prod closing handoff. ping me if any regression.
